title: searchContracts
responsibility: Ranks literal or regular-expression matches across stored contract metadata and returns one bounded snippet per contract.

inputs.name: searchContracts.entries
inputs.description: Filtered stored records, including declared state metadata when available; executable source is outside the search domain.

inputs.name: searchContracts.query
inputs.description: Nonempty literal substring by default, or a JavaScript expression without slash delimiters when regex is enabled.

inputs.name: searchContracts.options
inputs.description: Case sensitivity, regex mode and result limit. Search defaults to twenty results; upstream filtering is already applied.

outputs.name: searchContracts
outputs.description: At most limit or twenty ranked records, each with its best field, score and at-most-160-character context plus ellipses. Identity outranks title, responsibility, fields and dependencies/states; ties sort by id.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The search query is empty or the requested JavaScript regular expression cannot be compiled.
